name: btn-hover-down
title: Push Shadow Button
description: A rounded-rectangle Contact me button in a navy gradient with a solid blue shadow set behind its lower-right edge. On hover the button shifts into the shadow and the shadow disappears, so it looks pressed.
use: A primary button needs a chunky, physical feel and a clear pressed response on hover.
avoid: The hard shadow and fixed blue palette look heavy on light minimal pages, and the offset needs spare space.
a11y: It is a real button with visible text and a native focus ring, but the pressed shadow effect fires on hover only. (keyboard: yes, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A wide rounded-rectangle button in a navy-to-blue gradient with a bright blue outline and white Contact me text. A solid blue shadow block sits directly behind it, offset a few pixels right and down.
behaves: On hover the button slides right and down into the shadow's place while the shadow shrinks away, so the two become one flat slab. Moving off slides them back apart.
customise: The label, gradient, border and shadow colours and offsets are hardcoded classes; it accepts no props.
weight: light: One button, one CSS shadow and a short transform transition.
polishWhy: Crisp hard shadow and a satisfying click-like hover; simple but well executed.
